title: Truthful F# semantic confidence: exact only when the checked context carries no partial cause; indexed otherwise
outcome: One shared F# semantic response mapper makes symbol_at, definition, and references exact only for a checked context with no partial cause and indexed otherwise
acceptance: A singular features[] entry and README/agent-instructions/SKILL contract accompany Stage2 tests proving exact on a clean SDK-less context and indexed for each partial cause
disposal_reason: Duplicate confidence-authority work. The replacement shipped in commit 4bbcc3b, passed the recorded gates and original dual review, and is now completed with Fable #226/#233 evidence.
